context: Headline implementation: Java 17 mapMulti is a strong fit for conditional developer email extraction, and takeWhile is required for prefix semantics.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates TrainingAndPackets.java with the requested methods, nested interface/records, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves helper behavior
checklist.description: Returns only developers with incomplete training as a set of emails and returns only the packet prefix before the first loss spike.

checklist.name: Flattens company employees directly
checklist.description: Uses companies.stream().flatMap(company -> company.employees().stream()) or equivalent direct flattening rather than collecting nested employee sets before flattening.

checklist.name: Uses mapMulti or equivalent conditional emission cleanly
checklist.description: Uses Java 17 mapMulti with pattern matching for Developer, or gives full credit for an equivalently concise filter/cast/map stream chain, without unsafe casts before type checks. A cast after a verified instanceof/Class::isInstance filter is acceptable. Do not deduct merely because the safe equivalent does not use mapMulti, does not reuse a pattern variable, or uses an explicit safe cast in the following map step.

checklist.name: Uses takeWhile for prefix semantics
checklist.description: Implements packetsBeforeFirstLossSpike with takeWhile(packet -> packet.loss() <= threshold) or an equivalent prefix-preserving loop, not filter.

checklist.name: Uses appropriate collectors
checklist.description: Collects emails to a Set and packets to a List with Java 17-compatible collection terminals.

checklist.name: Keeps implementation compact
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated abstractions, mutable class state, or behavior not requested.
